test_pz_nn_RenameAxes: test the pz.nn.RenameAxes layer to rename axis labels from old to new names
test_pz_nn_NamedEinsum: test the pz.nn.NamedEinsum layer to perform named tensor contractions with einsum-style expressions
test_pz_nn_Linear: test the pz.nn.Linear layer created via from_config with input, output, and parallel axis specifications
test_pz_nn_Affine: test the pz.nn.Affine layer created via from_config with input, output, parallel, and broadcast axis configurations
test_pz_nn_Residual: test the pz.nn.Residual wrapper layer that adds its inner module output to the input
